params.body:
The byline under the standfirst was the browser's own select, which looks and behaves unlike everything around it. It now uses the Studio's own menu, the same `OneOf` as the shape picker (Post, Article, Deck).

## Change

- The name is a word with a small arrow; the list opens on hover or click, closes on Escape or a click outside, and ticks the current one.
- `OneOf` takes a heading entry (`{group: 'Writers'}`), so the list reads: the Editorial Team, then the writers under "Writers", then Another name... for an admin. Another name... still opens the text field.
- `OneOf` takes a `weight` for the current word; the byline uses 500, the shape picker keeps 600.

## Checks

- `npm test` 47/47, `vite build` clean.
- In a local Studio as an admin: the menu lists Trendwolves Editorial Team (ticked), Writers, the names, Another name...
params.title: Write: the byline uses the Studio's own menu
